geometry.boundary_partition: coordinate faces; split moving/thermal faces at their midpoint when specified

definitions.n: true outward unit normal of each supplied boundary entity
definitions.R: linear table (0,0),(0.1*end,1),(end,1); in steady analysis R=1
definitions.C: cellwise curl of the continuous nodal P1 potential; zero potential on all boundary-adjacent elements; scale the resulting field to specified max speed. In 2D use rotated gradient of scalar potential; in 3D curl of vector potential (0,0,psi). No projection of an inconsistent initial velocity is permitted.

detailed_spec.field_time_semantics: R/P/V in an expression are evaluated once at each history node; a string time_history names interpolation only, not an extra multiplier. A dictionary of samples is an explicit scalar multiplier on the spatial expression. A constant expression with linear history has equal endpoints. Initial fields only have the start frame.
detailed_spec.field_evaluation: Expressions construct INPUT samples only. Nodal expressions are evaluated on actual nodes then interpreted as P1, entity data are actual averages of the indicated input reconstruction. Actual phase is the specified phase-cell union. Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: exactly the task DATA; no output re-zeroing unless the declared gauge requires it

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately
extra: cell mean velocity/pressure/density/dynamic_viscosity/shear_rate

region-volume mean velocity
boundary traction and summed opposite fluid force

geometry.boundary_partition: coordinate faces; split moving/thermal faces at their midpoint when specified

definitions.n: true outward unit normal of each supplied boundary entity
definitions.R: linear table (0,0),(0.1*end,1),(end,1); in steady analysis R=1
definitions.C: cellwise curl of the continuous nodal P1 potential; zero potential on all boundary-adjacent elements; scale the resulting field to specified max speed. In 2D use rotated gradient of scalar potential; in 3D curl of vector potential (0,0,psi). No projection of an inconsistent initial velocity is permitted.

detailed_spec.field_time_semantics: R/P/V in an expression are evaluated once at each history node; a string time_history names interpolation only, not an extra multiplier. A dictionary of samples is an explicit scalar multiplier on the spatial expression. A constant expression with linear history has equal endpoints. Initial fields only have the start frame.
detailed_spec.field_evaluation: Expressions construct INPUT samples only. Nodal expressions are evaluated on actual nodes then interpreted as P1, entity data are actual averages of the indicated input reconstruction. Actual phase is the specified phase-cell union. Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: exactly the task DATA; no output re-zeroing unless the declared gauge requires it

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately
extra: cell mean velocity/pressure/density/dynamic_viscosity/shear_rate
point velocity and pressure at (.25,.35[, .45])*L in fluid
region-volume mean velocity
boundary traction and summed opposite fluid force
signed volume/mass flow on every open port
observations.extra_applicability: Use no duplicate compulsory field; boundary flow integrals only on actual open boundaries; point pressure gauge is not a second outlet constraint.

manufacturing_rules: All boundary entities belong to exactly one mechanical partition; independent thermal partition only when permitted by DATA.
Every numeric parameter and field uses the stated SI unit; no hidden Earth gravity or solver-specific physical input.
Output physical times are independent of native integration steps. Do not substitute a final frame for a steady state or for discrete statistics.
detailed_spec.physical_scope_status: specified; not numerically checked; no claim of solved-state admissibility

execution.producer: unmodified OpenCFD rhoSimpleFoam with native fixedTemperatureConstraint
execution.steady_stop: Native momentum residual only; closedVolume shifts absolute pressure after the pressure solve, making its normalized initial residual unsuitable for this global stopping criterion. Per-solve pressure tolerance remains 1e-10.

geometry.boundary_partition: coordinate faces; split moving/thermal faces at their midpoint when specified

definitions.n: true outward unit normal of each supplied boundary entity
definitions.R: linear table (0,0),(0.1*end,1),(end,1); in steady analysis R=1
definitions.C: cellwise curl of the continuous nodal P1 potential; zero potential on all boundary-adjacent elements; scale the resulting field to specified max speed. In 2D use rotated gradient of scalar potential; in 3D curl of vector potential (0,0,psi). No projection of an inconsistent initial velocity is permitted.

detailed_spec.field_time_semantics: R/P/V in an expression are evaluated once at each history node; a string time_history names interpolation only, not an extra multiplier. A dictionary of samples is an explicit scalar multiplier on the spatial expression. A constant expression with linear history has equal endpoints. Initial fields only have the start frame.
detailed_spec.field_evaluation: Expressions construct INPUT samples only. Nodal expressions are evaluated on actual nodes then interpreted as P1, entity data are actual averages of the indicated input reconstruction. Actual phase is the specified phase-cell union. Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: exactly the task DATA; no output re-zeroing unless the declared gauge requires it

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately
extra: cell mean velocity/pressure/density/dynamic_viscosity/shear_rate
point velocity and pressure at (.25,.35[, .45])*L in fluid
region-volume mean velocity
boundary traction and summed opposite fluid force
signed volume/mass flow on every open port
observations.extra_applicability: Use no duplicate compulsory field; boundary flow integrals only on actual open boundaries; point pressure gauge is not a second outlet constraint.

manufacturing_rules: All boundary entities belong to exactly one mechanical partition; independent thermal partition only when permitted by DATA.
Every numeric parameter and field uses the stated SI unit; no hidden Earth gravity or solver-specific physical input.
Output physical times are independent of native integration steps. Do not substitute a final frame for a steady state or for discrete statistics.
detailed_spec.physical_scope_status: specified; not numerically checked; no claim of solved-state admissibility

observed_status.mapping: Native stabilized P1 FlowSolver + HeatSolver, full symmetric stress, native Friction Heat, nodal constitutive coefficients; exact simplex means of native P1 outputs. Boussinesq retains base acceleration. Source P0 samples constructed once by fixed barycentric quadrature; no accuracy validation.

design.difference_and_coverage: 强制热输运、黏性耗散和真实三维流动
design.geometry_note: 3D题必须采用有限深度及真实端壁/非平面场，不能仅把2D结果挤出
remaining_before_execution: 确认现成生产者与本题闭合及边界等价
按detailed_spec生成实际自包含输入、原生配置并执行

geometry.boundary_partition: coordinate faces; split moving/thermal faces at their midpoint when specified

definitions.n: true outward unit normal of each supplied boundary entity
definitions.R: linear table (0,0),(0.1*end,1),(end,1); in steady analysis R=1
definitions.C: cellwise curl of the continuous nodal P1 potential; zero potential on all boundary-adjacent elements; scale the resulting field to specified max speed. In 2D use rotated gradient of scalar potential; in 3D curl of vector potential (0,0,psi). No projection of an inconsistent initial velocity is permitted.

detailed_spec.field_time_semantics: R/P/V in an expression are evaluated once at each history node; a string time_history names interpolation only, not an extra multiplier. A dictionary of samples is an explicit scalar multiplier on the spatial expression. A constant expression with linear history has equal endpoints. Initial fields only have the start frame.
detailed_spec.field_evaluation: Expressions construct INPUT samples only. Nodal expressions are evaluated on actual nodes then interpreted as P1, entity data are actual averages of the indicated input reconstruction. Actual phase is the specified phase-cell union. Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: exactly the task DATA; no output re-zeroing unless the declared gauge requires it

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately

manufacturing_rules: All boundary entities belong to exactly one mechanical partition; independent thermal partition only when permitted by DATA.
Every numeric parameter and field uses the stated SI unit; no hidden Earth gravity or solver-specific physical input.
Output physical times are independent of native integration steps. Do not substitute a final frame for a steady state or for discrete statistics.
detailed_spec.physical_scope_status: specified; not numerically checked; no claim of solved-state admissibility

observed_status.mapping: Native stabilized P1 FlowSolver + HeatSolver, full symmetric stress, native Friction Heat, nodal constitutive coefficients; exact simplex means of native P1 outputs. Boussinesq retains base acceleration. Source P0 samples constructed once by fixed barycentric quadrature; no accuracy validation.

definitions.R: linear table (0,0),(0.1*end,1),(end,1); in steady analysis R=1
definitions.C: cellwise curl of the continuous nodal P1 potential; zero potential on all boundary-adjacent elements; scale the resulting field to specified max speed. In 2D use rotated gradient of scalar potential; in 3D curl of vector potential (0,0,psi). No projection of an inconsistent initial velocity is permitted.

detailed_spec.field_time_semantics: R/P/V in an expression are evaluated once at each history node; a string time_history names interpolation only, not an extra multiplier. A dictionary of samples is an explicit scalar multiplier on the spatial expression. A constant expression with linear history has equal endpoints. Initial fields only have the start frame.
detailed_spec.field_evaluation: Expressions construct INPUT samples only. Nodal expressions are evaluated on actual nodes then interpreted as P1, entity data are actual averages of the indicated input reconstruction. Actual phase is the specified phase-cell union. Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: exactly the task DATA; no output re-zeroing unless the declared gauge requires it

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately

manufacturing_rules: All boundary entities belong to exactly one mechanical partition; independent thermal partition only when permitted by DATA.
Every numeric parameter and field uses the stated SI unit; no hidden Earth gravity or solver-specific physical input.
Output physical times are independent of native integration steps. Do not substitute a final frame for a steady state or for discrete statistics.
detailed_spec.physical_scope_status: specified; not numerically checked; no claim of solved-state admissibility

observed_status.mapping: Native FV cell means assigned to conforming child simplices. LRR uses full Reynolds-stress divergence and static pressure; kOmegaSST/WALE isotropic k is subtracted from native modified pressure, then mean gauge enforced. Statistics use actual equally weighted samples after spatial averages, population covariance. Body P0 input is volume-averaged into native source cells; URANS initial R=2k/3 I and epsilon=Cmu^.75 k^1.5/l. No resolution, closure-error or convergence certification.

design.difference_and_coverage: 平均响应或离散统计窗口；不得用末帧代替统计
design.geometry_note: 3D题必须采用有限深度及真实端壁/非平面场，不能仅把2D结果挤出
remaining_before_execution: 确认现成生产者与本题闭合及边界等价
按detailed_spec生成实际自包含输入、原生配置并执行

geometry.boundary_partition: coordinate faces; split moving/thermal faces at their midpoint when specified

definitions.n: true outward unit normal of each supplied boundary entity
definitions.R: linear table (0,0),(0.1*end,1),(end,1); in steady analysis R=1
definitions.C: cellwise curl of the continuous nodal P1 potential; zero potential on all boundary-adjacent elements; scale the resulting field to specified max speed. In 2D use rotated gradient of scalar potential; in 3D curl of vector potential (0,0,psi). No projection of an inconsistent initial velocity is permitted.

detailed_spec.field_time_semantics: R/P/V in an expression are evaluated once at each history node; a string time_history names interpolation only, not an extra multiplier. A dictionary of samples is an explicit scalar multiplier on the spatial expression. A constant expression with linear history has equal endpoints. Initial fields only have the start frame.
detailed_spec.field_evaluation: Expressions construct INPUT samples only. Nodal expressions are evaluated on actual nodes then interpreted as P1, entity data are actual averages of the indicated input reconstruction. Actual phase is the specified phase-cell union. Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: exactly the task DATA; no output re-zeroing unless the declared gauge requires it

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately

manufacturing_rules: All boundary entities belong to exactly one mechanical partition; independent thermal partition only when permitted by DATA.
Every numeric parameter and field uses the stated SI unit; no hidden Earth gravity or solver-specific physical input.
Output physical times are independent of native integration steps. Do not substitute a final frame for a steady state or for discrete statistics.
detailed_spec.physical_scope_status: specified; not numerically checked; no claim of solved-state admissibility

observed_status.mapping: Native FV cell means assigned to conforming child simplices. LRR uses full Reynolds-stress divergence and static pressure; kOmegaSST/WALE isotropic k is subtracted from native modified pressure, then mean gauge enforced. Statistics use actual equally weighted samples after spatial averages, population covariance. Body P0 input is volume-averaged into native source cells; URANS initial R=2k/3 I and epsilon=Cmu^.75 k^1.5/l. No resolution, closure-error or convergence certification.

Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: exactly the task DATA; no output re-zeroing unless the declared gauge requires it

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately

manufacturing_rules: All boundary entities belong to exactly one mechanical partition; independent thermal partition only when permitted by DATA.

detailed_spec.physical_scope_status: specified; not numerically checked; no claim of solved-state admissibility

observed_status.mapping: Native FV cell means assigned to conforming child simplices. LRR uses full Reynolds-stress divergence and static pressure; kOmegaSST/WALE isotropic k is subtracted from native modified pressure, then mean gauge enforced. Statistics use actual equally weighted samples after spatial averages, population covariance. Body P0 input is volume-averaged into native source cells; URANS initial R=2k/3 I and epsilon=Cmu^.75 k^1.5/l. No resolution, closure-error or convergence certification.

geometry.boundary_partition: coordinate faces; split moving/thermal faces at their midpoint when specified

definitions.n: true outward unit normal of each supplied boundary entity
definitions.R: linear table (0,0),(0.1*end,1),(end,1); in steady analysis R=1
definitions.C: cellwise curl of the continuous nodal P1 potential; zero potential on all boundary-adjacent elements; scale the resulting field to specified max speed. In 2D use rotated gradient of scalar potential; in 3D curl of vector potential (0,0,psi). No projection of an inconsistent initial velocity is permitted.

detailed_spec.field_time_semantics: R/P/V in an expression are evaluated once at each history node; a string time_history names interpolation only, not an extra multiplier. A dictionary of samples is an explicit scalar multiplier on the spatial expression. A constant expression with linear history has equal endpoints. Initial fields only have the start frame.
detailed_spec.field_evaluation: Expressions construct INPUT samples only. Nodal expressions are evaluated on actual nodes then interpreted as P1, entity data are actual averages of the indicated input reconstruction. Actual phase is the specified phase-cell union. Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: exactly the task DATA; no output re-zeroing unless the declared gauge requires it

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately

manufacturing_rules: All boundary entities belong to exactly one mechanical partition; independent thermal partition only when permitted by DATA.
Every numeric parameter and field uses the stated SI unit; no hidden Earth gravity or solver-specific physical input.
Output physical times are independent of native integration steps. Do not substitute a final frame for a steady state or for discrete statistics.
detailed_spec.initial_alpha_semantics: Pure 0/1 per supplied initial phase cell; actual interface is the union of these cell faces. An analytic mask is a geometry-construction recipe, not an extra subcell interface. Phase-cell conforming meshing must retain the listed contact/interface construction.
